title: Cross-Lingual TTS for Indian Languages: A Benchmark and Inference-Time Duration Estimation Strategies
abstract: arXiv:2610.14826v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent alignment-free Text-to-Speech (TTS) models achieve high synthesis quality by removing explicit alignment modules and simplifying training. However, they often struggle in cross-lingual scenarios due to differences in character durations across languages, leading to duration mismatch and degraded speech quality. Existing approaches typically address this issue using explicit duration predictors, increasing model complexity. Systematic evaluation of TTS performance for Indian languages in cross-lingual settings remains under-explored due to the lack of standardized evaluation benchmarks. In this work, we construct a cross-lingual evaluation benchmark covering English and nine Indian languages and propose a language-aware inference-time duration estimation strategy for alignment-free TTS that incorporates language-specific duration-per character statistics without retraining or architectural modifications. translated_title: 面向印度语言的跨语言文本转语音：基准测试与推理时音长估计策略
translated_abstract: 近来的无对齐文本转语音（TTS）模型通过移除显式对齐模块和简化训练流程实现了高质量的语音合成。然而，由于不同语言之间字符音长的差异，这类模型在跨语言场景中往往表现不佳，导致音长不匹配和语音质量下降。现有方法通常采用显式音长预测器来解决这一问题，但这会增加模型的复杂度。此外，由于缺乏标准化的评估基准，针对印度语言在跨语言场景下TTS性能的系统性评估仍然处于探索不足的状态。在本工作中，我们构建了一个涵盖英语和九种印度语言的跨语言评估基准，并提出了一种面向无对齐TTS的语言感知推理时音长估计策略，该策略融入了特定语言的每字符音长统计信息，且无需重新训练或修改模型架构。我们进一步开发了启发式（方法）……
tldr: 该论文构建了涵盖英语和九种印度语言的跨语言TTS评估基准，并提出一种无需重新训练或修改架构的语言感知推理时音长估计策略，解决了无对齐TTS模型在跨语言场景中因字符音长差异导致的语音质量下降问题。
